scientific_integrity: Exact finite local word enumerations establish needed coefficients, symbolic overlap counts prove formulas for every n>=3, and independent global exact checks corroborate without replacing proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform pairings of fixed cyclic endpoints only; no general random-chord sampling law, no nonlinear prediction theorem, no joint CLT, no claim of exhaustive historical priority.
title: An exact edge–triangle correlation gap in random chord intersection graphs
